case: 林悦｜内容运营 · 项目执行（虚构示例）
common_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished Xiaohongshu campaign poster, portrait 3:4 aspect ratio, ideally 1086x1448 pixels. This is one of a cohesive six-image series for the Chinese custom personal-website studio "一页映".
Audience: ordinary working people with a résumé and project experience, who may want an attractive custom personal website. The poster must create desire for the finished website.
Art direction: premium clean editorial product advertising, pale cool grey #f4f6fa background, deep navy #172b4d typography, restrained cobalt blue #3d63d8. Crisp large Chinese sans-serif headlines, elegant whitespace and fine rules. Subtle realistic device shadows and silver edges, no purple gradients, no decorative blobs, no random decorative objects. Professional but visually compelling.
Use the supplied real HTML screenshots as content and layout references inside screens. Keep the same fictional person name 林悦 / LIN YUE, the same job 内容运营 · 项目执行 and project 城市读书计划. Do not invent a new UI or add people, a headshot, photos, company logos, metrics, contact details, email, live domain, QR code, testimonial, prices or results. All data are expressly a design demonstration. Screens must have physically plausible geometry, near-front-on so text is legible.
Series typography: large headline at upper left, top tiny-but-legible studio label "一页映 / 个人网站设计", comfortable horizontal margins ~68px. Footer includes exact attribution "网页设计与制作：一页映" and exact readable label "设计示意 · 非真实交付案例". The labels must be large enough to read, with no invented Chinese characters.
Avoid paragraphs and small long captions. Copy quoted in each slide is exact; no unrequested copy. Single finished poster, no montage of six posters.

images.headline: 只有一份简历\n也能做成这样
images.subtitle: 把经历与项目，变成你的个人网站
images.composition: Hero cover. Headline dominates upper quarter. In lower two-thirds, a large beautifully presented floating desktop browser showing reference desktop hero, a smaller matching phone standing at lower right showing reference mobile hero, and a small clean résumé sheet at lower left. Desktop is main hero, not dominated by blank device shells. Preserve full website content. Small résumé may use source résumé reference. One small caption by résumé: 同内容排版示意. Screen and paper details must stay geometrically intact. Give the poster a premium clean product-launch feel.

images.revision_prompt:

Edit image 1, the finished slide 06 campaign poster. Image 2 is reference ONLY for exact 3:4 canvas aspect ratio and series sizing.
CRITICAL: produce the revised poster at EXACT 3:4 portrait ratio, 1086 pixels wide by 1448 pixels tall. The input slide is too tall. Reflow its spacing to fit 3:4; retain ALL text, attribution, footer and devices. No stretching, no cropping text off. Reduce the space around the central device grouping and material labels slightly as needed.
Keep design, colors, typography, headline, subtitle, device appearance, fictional person 林悦, project 城市读书计划 and content unchanged. Headline exactly 你的简历 / 会变成什么样？. Subtitle 从你已经有的资料开始. Keep material labels 简历 / 项目介绍 / 相关材料. Keep blue CTA 聊聊你的个人网站. Keep line 告诉我你的职业方向，以及已有资料。 Keep studio 一页映 | 个人网站设计, page counter 06 / 06, footer 设计示意 · 非真实交付案例 and 网页设计与制作：一页映. All must be fully visible with comfortable padding. Do not introduce new text or objects. This is a targeted correction of aspect ratio and vertical spacing ONLY. Final output MUST be 3:4, same shape as image 2.
